title: Inspector Gadget
description: This is the Inspector Gadget Mod! I added some of the most famous gadgets.
body:
Inspector Gadget Mod is a mod that introduces some of the most famous gadgets of the funny inspector. You want to use the Helicopter Cap and the Missile? You are a fan of Gadget and you want to become him in-game? Well, this mod is for you.
How to use: 
            
            C: get the Squashammer
            
            V: get the Glidembrella
            
            X: launch a Gadget Missile (I know you already want to obliterate a village!)
            
            Z: activate the Gadget Skates
            
            R: activate the Helicopter Cap

            Double Space: Hyper Jump with the Gadget Springs

Note: I'm INCREDIBLY bad at drawing, so if the images are poor, sorry 
Note 2: This is my first mod! I'm really excited!
The Modder
